channel.title: Cloud Health Office release notes
channel.description: New releases of Cloud Health Office, the core administration platform for health plans.

item.title: Cloud Health Office v6.2.0: The Shining
item.description: Cloud Health Office v6.2.0 (The Shining): Load a plan's data from its core: the CPCDS daily drop; shadow adjudication (#1668).

item.title: Cloud Health Office v6.1.0: Spartacus
item.description: Cloud Health Office v6.1.0 (Spartacus): SMART Backend Services, in both directions; the public Provider Directory is Plan-Net 1.2.0.

item.title: Cloud Health Office v6.0.0: Paths of Glory
item.description: Cloud Health Office v6.0.0 (Paths of Glory): Claims pay correctly, through one adjudicator; inpatient pricing from CMS's rules.

item.title: Cloud Health Office v5.0.0: 2001: A Payer Odyssey
item.description: Cloud Health Office v5.0.0 (2001: A Payer Odyssey): CMS-0057-F: Cloud Health Office as the native authorization and data backend.
